system.description: Loyal mortals (or ghouls) who serve your needs first, watching over your property, managing your assets, or performing menial tasks. Unlike Allies, Retainers are nearly always available. A Retainer assigned to manage your assets adds one to your maximum Influence Traits. Declaring a Retainer a ghoul costs you one Blood Trait at the start of each session to maintain them.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
